reasons: Both answers fully cover all three rubric items with correct probe semantics, a clear causal explanation and sensible startupProbe/failureThreshold settings. B adds practical value: a TCP-socket stopgap when code cannot change immediately and concrete verification commands. A opens with a stray, unrelated timestamp line and says Kubernetes 'schedules a new container' on liveness failure, although the kubelet restarts the container in place. B's HPA scale-out claim is somewhat dubious.

A: Says K8s 'schedules a new container' on liveness failure; the kubelet restarts the container in place within the same pod.
B: Claims HPA will scale out because pods are NotReady; HPA scales on metrics and treats not-ready pods conservatively, so this feedback loop is overstated.
